elements.text: First officer's failure to properly apply crosswind landing techniques to align the airplane with the runway centerline
First officer's failure to properly arrest the airplane’s descent rate (flare) before touchdown
Captain's failure to adequately monitor the first officer’s performance during the final approach and landing
Captain's failure to command or initiate corrective action during the final approach and landing
First officer did not properly apply control wheel and rudder inputs to align the airplane with the runway centerline
First officer did not apply appropriate back pressure on the control column to arrest the airplane’s rate of descent before touchdown
Excessive vertical and lateral forces on the right main landing gear exceeded design limits, resulting in fracture and collapse
FedEx’s inadequate hands-on emergency procedures training contributed to the unintentional release of the slide/raft
Differences between the trainer and the door/slide installation on the accident airplane contributed to the unintentional release of the slide/raft
Nonrevenue FedEx pilot mistakenly pulled both manual inflation and slide/raft disengage handles due to lack of familiarity
Pilots delayed evacuation to salvage personal items, exposing themselves to unnecessary risk
ATC ground controller did not give priority to ARFF vehicles, causing unnecessary delay in assistance
Captain and first officer were properly certificated and qualified
Fatigue was not a factor in this accident
Accident airplane was properly certificated and maintained with no preexisting failures
Cargo and loading were not factors in the accident
Differences between MD-11 and MD-10 handling characteristics were not an issue
Air traffic control was not a factor in the accident
Atmospheric conditions were within performance capabilities with no significant windshear
Recommendation for a proactive program to identify and train crewmembers with performance deficiencies
FAA Order 8400.10 guidance is not adequate for ensuring comprehensive emergency exit door/slide training
Recommendation for ATC controllers to relay pertinent information to ARFF personnel
Requirement for MD-10 flight data recorder data to meet specific regulatory standards
